name: listing_toolbar
title: Listing Toolbar
description: Settings of the toolbars above the listings (search input, filters, sort, results count), one item per toolbar in data_items_listing_toolbar.json. Read by filters_post_projects, hobby_pc_video_games_filters and search through "toolbar": "<_id>". listing_toolbar.js keeps the toolbar state in the URL (?q=, one param per filter, ?sort=&order=) and restores it on load.
